<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0">
<title>AI 이커머스 풀 자동화 스위트</title>
<style>
:root{
  --indigo:#6366f1;--violet:#8b5cf6;--sky:#0ea5e9;--amber:#f59e0b;
  --emerald:#10b981;--pink:#ec4899;--red:#ef4444;
  --bg:#050508;--surface:#0d0d1a;--surface2:#111127;--surface3:#16163a;
  --border:rgba(255,255,255,.07);--border2:rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  --text:#f1f5f9;--muted:#64748b;--muted2:#94a3b8;
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{font-family:'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Malgun Gothic','Noto Sans KR',sans-serif;
  background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);width:800px;margin:0 auto;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}

/* ══ SCROLLBAR ══ */
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#0a0a0f;}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--indigo);border-radius:2px;}

/* ══ UTILITY ══ */
.grad-text{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff,#a5b4fc);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
.grad-text-green{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#34d399,#6ee7b7);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
.tag{display:inline-block;background:rgba(99,102,241,.15);color:#a5b4fc;font-size:10px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;margin:3px 2px 0 0;}
.glass{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border:1px solid var(--border2);}

/* ══ NOISE OVERLAY ══ */
.noise::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.04'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  pointer-events:none;z-index:1;border-radius:inherit;}

/* ══ GLOW BLOBS ══ */
.blob{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(80px);pointer-events:none;z-index:0;}

/* ── SECTION BASE ── */
.section{padding:52px 50px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);position:relative;}
.section:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.sec-label{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:3px;color:var(--indigo);margin-bottom:14px;}
.sec-title{font-size:24px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:8px;}
.sec-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted2);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:28px;}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════
   HERO
══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero{
  min-height:460px;padding:56px 50px 48px;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 120% 80% at 60% -10%,rgba(99,102,241,.18) 0%,transparent 60%),
             radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 90% 80%,rgba(139,92,246,.12) 0%,transparent 50%),
             linear-gradient(180deg,#0a0820 0%,#050508 100%);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.hero-badge{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  background:rgba(99,102,241,.12);border:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.3);
  color:#a5b4fc;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:1.5px;
  padding:7px 16px;border-radius:20px;margin-bottom:24px;
}
.hero-badge .live-dot{width:7px;height:7px;background:#34d399;border-radius:50%;
  box-shadow:0 0 8px #34d399;animation:live-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes live-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.5;transform:scale(.8)}}
.hero-title{font-size:46px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-1px;margin-bottom:16px;}
.hero-desc{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted2);line-height:1.7;max-width:440px;margin-bottom:36px;}

/* 플로팅 스탯 카드들 */
.hero-layout{display:flex;gap:28px;align-items:flex-end;}
.hero-left{flex:1;}
.hero-right{flex-shrink:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;width:200px;}
.stat-float{
  background:rgba(13,13,26,.8);border:1px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius:14px;padding:16px 18px;backdrop-filter:blur(20px);
  position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.stat-float::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(99,102,241,.5),transparent);}
.stat-float .sf-val{font-size:26px;font-weight:900;line-height:1;}
.stat-float .sf-lbl{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px;}
.stat-float .sf-icon{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:6px;}

/* 가격 박스 */
.price-row{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:stretch;}
.price-card{border-radius:14px;padding:18px 22px;flex:1;}
.price-card.primary{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--indigo),var(--violet));
  box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(99,102,241,.35);}
.price-card.secondary{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border2);}
.pc-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;opacity:.7;margin-bottom:6px;}
.pc-amount{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;line-height:1;}
.pc-unit{font-size:11px;opacity:.7;margin-top:4px;}
.pc-discount{
  display:inline-block;background:var(--red);color:#fff;
  font-size:10px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:4px;margin-top:8px;}

/* ══ TICKER ══ */
.ticker{
  background:rgba(99,102,241,.08);border-top:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.15);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.15);padding:10px 0;overflow:hidden;
}
.ticker-inner{display:flex;gap:0;animation:ticker-move 20s linear infinite;width:max-content;}
@keyframes ticker-move{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.ticker-item{
  white-space:nowrap;padding:0 32px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted2);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);
}
.ticker-item .ti-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;}
.ticker-item .ti-val{font-weight:700;color:var(--text);}

/* ══ SYSTEM OVERVIEW ══ */
.overview{
  padding:52px 50px;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 80% at 50% 50%,rgba(99,102,241,.05) 0%,transparent 70%);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.overview-inner{display:flex;gap:36px;align-items:center;}

/* SVG 오빗 */
.orbit-svg-wrap{position:relative;width:280px;height:280px;flex-shrink:0;}
.orbit-svg{width:100%;height:100%;}
.orbit-center-node{
  position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:50%;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--indigo),var(--violet));
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(99,102,241,.5),0 0 80px rgba(99,102,241,.2);z-index:5;
}
.orbit-center-node .ocn-icon{font-size:24px;}
.orbit-center-node .ocn-text{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;color:#e0e7ff;margin-top:2px;}
/* 4개 위성 노드 */
.satellite{
  position:absolute;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:10px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;z-index:5;
  box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}
.satellite span{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:2px;}
.sat-a{top:4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0369a1,#0ea5e9);}
.sat-b{top:50%;right:4px;transform:translateY(-50%);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#b45309,#f59e0b);}
.sat-c{bottom:4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#065f46,#10b981);}
.sat-d{top:50%;left:4px;transform:translateY(-50%);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#9d174d,#ec4899);}
/* 회전 링 */
.ring{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;border-radius:50%;border:1px dashed;}
.ring1{width:170px;height:170px;margin:-85px 0 0 -85px;border-color:rgba(99,102,241,.2);animation:rot 18s linear infinite;}
.ring2{width:250px;height:250px;margin:-125px 0 0 -125px;border-color:rgba(99,102,241,.1);animation:rot 28s linear infinite reverse;}
@keyframes rot{from{transform:rotate(0)}to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
/* 데이터 패킷 SVG 점 */
.dp{
  position:absolute;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#a5b4fc;
  top:50%;left:50%;transform-origin:0 0;
  animation:orbit-anim 4s linear infinite;
}
.dp:nth-child(2){animation-delay:-1s;}
.dp:nth-child(3){animation-delay:-2s;}
.dp:nth-child(4){animation-delay:-3s;}
@keyframes orbit-anim{
  from{transform:rotate(0deg) translateX(85px) rotate(0deg);opacity:0;}
  10%{opacity:1;}90%{opacity:1;}
  to{transform:rotate(360deg) translateX(85px) rotate(-360deg);opacity:0;}
}

.overview-text{flex:1;}
.overview-text h2{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:12px;}
.overview-text p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted2);line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:20px;}
.kpi-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;}
.kpi-card{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;
  padding:14px;text-align:center;
}
.kpi-card .kv{font-size:22px;font-weight:900;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--indigo),#a78bfa);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text;}
.kpi-card .kl{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px;}

/* ══ TARGET ══ */
.target-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;}
.target-card{
  background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:14px;padding:22px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  transition:border-color .3s;
}
.target-card::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(99,102,241,.4),transparent);
}
.target-card .tc-icon{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:12px;}
.target-card .tc-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;}
.target-card .tc-desc{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted2);line-height:1.6;}

/* ══ BOT DEMOS — BENTO ══ */
.bento-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;}
.bento-card{
  background:var(--surface);border-radius:18px;padding:24px;
  border:1px solid var(--border);overflow:hidden;position:relative;
}
.bento-card.full{grid-column:1/-1;}
.bc-header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:18px;}
.bc-badge{
  width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;font-size:16px;font-weight:900;flex-shrink:0;
}
.bc-badge.a{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0369a1,#0ea5e9);}
.bc-badge.b{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#b45309,#f59e0b);}
.bc-badge.c{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#065f46,#10b981);}
.bc-badge.d{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#9d174d,#ec4899);}
.bc-name{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;}
.bc-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;}

/* A봇 플로우 */
.flow-track{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;margin-bottom:14px;}
.flow-step{
  flex:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:10px;padding:12px 10px;text-align:center;
}
.flow-step.highlight{border-color:rgba(14,165,233,.4);background:rgba(14,165,233,.06);}
.flow-step .fs-icon{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:5px;}
.flow-step .fs-name{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;}
.flow-step .fs-sub{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;}
.flow-sep{
  width:28px;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;position:relative;
}
.flow-sep::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;width:100%;height:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(14,165,233,.3),rgba(14,165,233,.8),rgba(14,165,233,.3));
}
.flow-dot{
  width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--sky);
  position:absolute;animation:fd-move 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes fd-move{0%{left:0;opacity:0}20%{opacity:1}80%{opacity:1}100%{left:calc(100% - 6px);opacity:0}}
.flow-arrow{color:rgba(14,165,233,.7);font-size:10px;position:relative;z-index:1;}
/* 등록 결과 카드 */
.reg-card{
  background:rgba(14,165,233,.06);border:1px solid rgba(14,165,233,.2);
  border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;
}
.reg-card .rc-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.reg-card .rc-icon{font-size:18px;flex-shrink:0;}
.reg-card .rc-text{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted2);line-height:1.5;}
.reg-card .rc-text b{color:#38bdf8;}
.reg-card .rc-meta{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.reg-card .rm-tag{
  background:rgba(14,165,233,.1);color:#38bdf8;font-size:10px;
  padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;
}
/* 타이핑 커서 */
.cursor-type{
  display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;
  border-right:2px solid #38bdf8;
  animation:typing-loop 4s steps(25) infinite, cursor-blink .7s step-end infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes typing-loop{0%,5%{width:0}70%,95%{width:100%}100%{width:0}}
@keyframes cursor-blink{from{border-color:#38bdf8}to{border-color:transparent}}

/* B봇 */
.b-layout{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;}
.b-steps{flex:1;}
.b-step{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;
  padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
.b-step:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.b-step-num{
  width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--amber),#fbbf24);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;
  margin-top:1px;
}
.b-step-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:#e2e8f0;}
.b-step-sub{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;}
/* 폰 목업 */
.phone{width:130px;flex-shrink:0;}
.phone-shell{
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1e1e30,#151525);
  border-radius:26px;padding:8px;
  border:2px solid #2a2a45;
  box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05);
}
.phone-notch{width:40px;height:5px;background:#2a2a45;border-radius:3px;margin:0 auto 6px;}
.phone-screen{
  background:#000;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;
  aspect-ratio:9/19;position:relative;
}
.shorts-bg{
  width:100%;height:100%;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#0f0f1e 0%,#1a0a3e 40%,#0a1628 100%);
  position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;padding:10px 8px;
}
.shorts-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(0,0,0,.85) 0%,transparent 55%);}
.shorts-sparkle{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;}
.sp{position:absolute;width:2px;height:2px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(245,158,11,.7);animation:sp-up 2.5s ease-in infinite;}
.sp:nth-child(1){left:15%;animation-delay:0s;}
.sp:nth-child(2){left:40%;animation-delay:.7s;animation-duration:3s;}
.sp:nth-child(3){left:65%;animation-delay:1.4s;animation-duration:2s;}
.sp:nth-child(4){left:80%;animation-delay:.3s;animation-duration:3.5s;}
@keyframes sp-up{0%{transform:translateY(120px);opacity:0}50%{opacity:.8}100%{transform:translateY(-10px);opacity:0}}
.shorts-content{position:relative;z-index:2;}
.sc-label{font-size:7px;color:#fbbf24;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:4px;}
.sc-title{font-size:8px;color:#fff;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:5px;}
.sc-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px;margin-bottom:6px;}
.sc-tag{background:rgba(245,158,11,.25);color:#fbbf24;font-size:6px;padding:1px 4px;border-radius:2px;}
.sc-progress{height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:1px;overflow:hidden;}
.sc-bar{height:100%;width:60%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f59e0b,#fbbf24);animation:bar-go 3s linear infinite;border-radius:1px;}
@keyframes bar-go{0%{width:0}100%{width:100%}}
.sc-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;font-size:12px;}
/* 플랫폼 뱃지 */
.platform-row{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:12px;}
.p-badge{
  flex:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius:7px;padding:6px;text-align:center;
}
.p-badge .pb-dot{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 4px;animation:live-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;}
.p-badge .pb-name{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted2);}

/* C봇 SEO */
.seo-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 24px 1fr;gap:10px;align-items:center;}
.seo-box{
  border-radius:12px;padding:16px;
}
.seo-box.before{background:rgba(239,68,68,.05);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.2);}
.seo-box.after{background:rgba(16,185,129,.05);border:1px solid rgba(16,185,129,.2);}
.seo-tag{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:10px;}
.before .seo-tag{background:rgba(239,68,68,.15);color:#f87171;}
.after .seo-tag{background:rgba(16,185,129,.15);color:#34d399;}
.seo-title-before{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted2);line-height:1.6;}
.seo-title-after{font-size:11px;color:var(--text);line-height:1.6;}
.kw{background:rgba(16,185,129,.2);color:#34d399;padding:1px 4px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:700;}
.seo-metrics{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:12px;}
.sm{flex:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-radius:7px;padding:8px;text-align:center;}
.sm .smv{font-size:14px;font-weight:900;}
.sm .sml{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px;}
.before .smv{color:#f87171;}.after .smv{color:#34d399;}
.seo-arrow{font-size:20px;color:var(--indigo);text-align:center;animation:arr-bounce 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;}
@keyframes arr-bounce{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.2)}}
/* 네이버 UI 목업 */
.naver-mock{
  background:#f5f6f7;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin-top:12px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
}
.naver-header{background:#03c75a;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;padding:5px 8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.naver-logo{color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.5px;}
.naver-search{
  background:#fff;border-radius:3px;padding:3px 6px;
  font-size:9px;color:#333;flex:1;
}
.naver-product{padding:8px 6px;}
.np-rank{
  display:inline-block;background:var(--red);color:#fff;
  font-size:8px;font-weight:700;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:2px;margin-bottom:4px;
}
.np-rank.green{background:var(--emerald);}
.np-title{font-size:9px;color:#1a1a1a;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:3px;}
.np-price{font-size:10px;color:#e74c3c;font-weight:700;}
.np-meta{font-size:8px;color:#999;margin-top:2px;}

/* D봇 텔레그램 */
.d-layout{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:flex-start;}
.tg-device{width:190px;flex-shrink:0;}
.tg-shell{
  background:#17212b;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;
  border:2px solid #232e3c;
  box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}
.tg-nav{
  background:#232e3c;padding:10px 12px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
}
.tg-av{
  width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pink),#f472b6);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;
}
.tg-info .tg-name{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;}
.tg-info .tg-status{font-size:9px;color:#34d399;}
.tg-body{padding:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-height:220px;}
.tg-bubble{
